title: DIR-010: Multi-Tenant AI Governance Self-Healing Resolution & 10/10 Cuba M3 AI Generation Studio Modernization
spec:
# SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE
Directive ID: DIR-010
Title: Multi-Tenant AI Governance Self-Healing Resolution & 10/10 Cuba M3 AI Generation Studio Modernization
Target Project: IME365 (d:\xampp\htdocs\IME365)
Priority: P0 (Critical Production Architecture, Multi-Tenant Governance & AI Studio Quality)
Executive Engineering Lead: Antigravity (Google DeepMind)
Implementation Engine: Cline / Claude Code CLI

### 1.1 Objective & Forensic Findings:
1. Multi-Tenant AI Block Root Cause: User OhZdiSIFL7ePA1TMkfu9bnR935D3 (bhaskar.beyond@gmail.com, SUPER_ADMIN) holds 3 active organizational tenant memberships in MariaDB enterprise_memberships. When calling AI endpoints (/api/generate-content, /api/generate-ai-cover-letter, etc.), Express middleware aiGovernanceMiddleware() executes resolveAiGovernance(req). Because req.get('x-tenant-id') is null, loadApplicableTenantMembership returns AMBIGUOUS_ACTIVE_TENANT, triggering HTTP 400 TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED with primaryTenantId. The frontend Axios client (frontend/src/lib/api-client.ts) never injected X-Tenant-Id nor implemented the legacy self-healing retry from src/services/aiService.js, blocking all AI generation completely.
2. AI Generation Studio Modernization (10/10 Cuba M3 Standard): Replace basic inline textboxes with an executive-grade AI experience across the candidate hub:
   - Build frontend/src/components/ui/ai-processing-modal.tsx: Cuba M3 Executive Glassmorphic processing dialog with ambient blur, 5-stage progress ladder, live elapsed timer, rotating pro-tips, and keyboard escape cancellation.
   - Modernize SummaryStep in frontend/src/pages/dashboard/resume-builder.tsx into a 10/10 Executive Bio Studio: tone selector chips (Balanced, Concise, Technical, Executive, Results-Focused, Leadership), Master Profile bio sync ('Import from Master Profile', 'Save to Profile'), ATS word count density meter with sweet spot guidance (50-200 words), AiProcessingModal integration, and high-impact draft review card with side-by-side comparison.
   - Wire AiProcessingModal into cover-letter-builder.tsx and interview-coach.tsx for smooth visual feedback during LLM generation.

# SECTION 2 — ABSOLUTE MODE RESTRICTIONS: PLAN MODE VS ACT MODE
2.1 PLAN MODE:
- Developer inspects frontend/src/lib/api-client.ts, frontend/src/lib/ai-content.ts, frontend/src/lib/cover-letters.ts, frontend/src/pages/dashboard/resume-builder.tsx, frontend/src/pages/dashboard/cover-letter-builder.tsx, frontend/src/pages/dashboard/interview-coach.tsx, and backend/index.js.
- Formulate detailed implementation plan and submit via Bridge CLI.
- No application code modification permitted until formal Lead approval.
2.2 ACT MODE:
- Implement surgical code updates in frontend/src/ and backend/index.js.
- Execute local static validation (tsc -b, build) and Playwright E2E verification.
- Produce evidence package and request Lead review.

# SECTION 3 — PRE-FLIGHT REPOSITORY AND WORKSPACE VERIFICATION
- Target Workspace: d:\xampp\htdocs\IME365
- Verify git status, active branch, and package manifests (frontend/package.json).
- Confirm backend server is running and MariaDB connection pool is active.
- Confirm legacy reference implementations in src/services/aiService.js and src/components/BuildResume/steps/SummaryStep.jsx are readable.

# SECTION 4 — NON-NEGOTIABLE PROJECT INVARIANTS
4.1 Zero Synthetic / Mock Data: Never override authentic candidate data or simulate LLM responses. All AI calls must bind to authentic backend routes and live LLM providers.
4.2 Strict Multi-Tenant Isolation: Tenant context resolution must remain deterministic, auditable, and never leak state across organizational boundaries.
4.3 Cuba M3 Executive Glassmorphism: All modals, dialogs, tone selector chips, and progress bars must adhere to Cuba design tokens with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility (landmarks, focus traps, contrast >= 4.5:1).
4.4 Performance Budget: Frontend build must compile in under 3.0s with zero TypeScript compilation errors.

# SECTION 5 — TARGET ARCHITECTURE & FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
5.1 API Client Tenant Resolution & Self-Healing (frontend/src/lib/api-client.ts):
- Add resolveActiveTenantId(): checks memoryActiveTenantId, URL search params (?tenant=, ?tenantId=), sessionStorage ('activeTenantId', 'selectedTenantId', 'enterprise_context_request:*'), and localStorage ('activeTenantId', 'selectedTenantId', 'enterprise_context_request:*').
- In request interceptor: for tenant-aware routes (/generate-content, /generate-ai-cover-letter, /generate-interview, /live-interview, /parse-resume, /check-grammar, /ai-usage, /enterprise), inject X-Tenant-Id if resolved.
- In response interceptor: intercept HTTP 400 TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED; extract primaryTenantId from error payload, persist to storage, set originalRequest.headers['X-Tenant-Id'] = candidate, and transparently retry the request.
5.2 Backend Route Integrity (backend/index.js):
- Add /check-grammar to isTenantAwareRoute (line 531) to prevent TENANT_CONTEXT_UNSUPPORTED_FOR_LEGACY_ROUTE when X-Tenant-Id is passed.
5.3 Cuba M3 AiProcessingModal (frontend/src/components/ui/ai-processing-modal.tsx):
- Build accessible Radix Dialog with Cuba M3 Executive Glassmorphism.
- Dual ambient glow background orbs (indigo-500/10, purple-500/10 blur-3xl).
- 5-stage progress ladder: Context Extraction -> ATS Guideline Calibration -> Executive Synthesis -> Grammar & Impact Polish -> Output Validation.
- Live elapsed seconds timer and smooth progress indicator bar approaching 95%.
- Rotating career pro-tips (PRO_TIPS) every 4.5s.
- Escape key listener, abort controller cancellation trigger.
5.4 Modernized SummaryStep (frontend/src/pages/dashboard/resume-builder.tsx):
- Full 10/10 Executive Bio Studio.
- 6 tone chips (Balanced, Concise, Technical, Executive, Results-Focused, Leadership).
- Master Profile bio sync ('Import from Master Profile', 'Save to Profile') with live profile API integration.
- Real-time ATS word & character counter with target density indicators (50-200 words sweet spot).
- AiProcessingModal visual feedback during generation.
- High-impact draft review card with side-by-side comparison, highlight tags, and one-click 'Use Draft'.
5.5 Integration in Cover Letter & Interview Coach:
- Connect AiProcessingModal to cover-letter-builder.tsx during generateCoverLetterDraft.
- Connect AiProcessingModal to interview-coach.tsx during generateAssessment.

# SECTION 6 — ACCESSIBILITY & UX STANDARDS
- WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance: All modal dialogs must trap focus, handle Escape dismissal, expose role='dialog' and aria-modal='true', and meet 4.5:1 text contrast ratios.
- Smooth CSS micro-animations without layout shifts or FOUC.

# SECTION 7 — SECURITY & DATA INTEGRITY
- Zero token leakage; authenticate all AI requests using Firebase Bearer tokens.
- Strict tenant boundary enforcement: client must never masquerade as an unauthorized tenant.

# SECTION 8 — RECOVERY & ROLLBACK
- Changes isolated to frontend/src/lib/, frontend/src/components/ui/, frontend/src/pages/dashboard/, and backend/index.js.
- Preserve git working tree clean baseline.

# SECTION 9 — TEST STRATEGY AND ACCEPTANCE REQUIREMENTS
- Layer 1: npx tsc -b in frontend/ must exit 0 with zero errors.
- Layer 2: npm --prefix frontend run build must exit 0 within 3.0s.
- Layer 3: End-to-end node integration test verifying that resolveAiGovernance succeeds with X-Tenant-Id and that live generation succeeds for OhZdiSIFL7ePA1TMkfu9bnR935D3.
- Layer 4: Playwright headless browser test verifying:
  a) /dashboard/resume-builder Summary step opens Executive Bio Studio with tone selector, ATS word counter, and AiProcessingModal.
  b) AI generation succeeds live without 400 TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED error.
  c) Cover letter AI draft generation triggers AiProcessingModal and populates letter body.

# SECTION 10 — REQUIRED FORENSIC DELIVERABLES
- Implementation Plan (Bridge ledger)
- Git Diff Audit
- Live AI generation test log & Playwright test results

# SECTION 11 — SEVERITY & WAVE SEQUENCING
Severity: P0 Critical
- Wave 1: Frontend api-client.ts tenant resolution & self-healing retry + backend/index.js route check.
- Wave 2: AiProcessingModal component creation (frontend/src/components/ui/ai-processing-modal.tsx).
- Wave 3: SummaryStep modernization in resume-builder.tsx (tone selector, Master Bio sync, ATS meter, draft review).
- Wave 4: Integration in cover-letter-builder.tsx and interview-coach.tsx.
- Wave 5: Verification gates (tsc -b, build, live generation, Playwright) and evidence submission.

# SECTION 12 — RESPONSE & COMPLETION REPORT
- Structured exit report with objective verification, file diffs, test logs, and visual evidence.

# SECTION 13 — BRIDGE SUBMISSION SYNTAX
Submit plan using:
bridge dev plan --directive DIR-010 --projectDir "d:\xampp\htdocs\IME365" --summary "<Plan summary>" --steps "<Step 1>;<Step 2>;<Step 3>"

# SECTION 14 — FINAL EXECUTIVE INSTRUCTION
Execute plan mode investigation, verify the actual codebase, submit detailed architectural plan, and await formal Lead approval before modifying application code.
